// CASE group_plain_await expect=pass
func g1(_ items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask { await work(item) }
    }
  }
}

// CASE group_plain_try_await expect=pass
func g2(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask { try await save(item) }
    }
    try await group.waitForAll()
  }
}

// CASE group_priority_await expect=pass
func g3(_ items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }
    }
  }
}

// CASE group_priority_try_await expect=pass
func g4(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask(priority: .utility) { try await save(item) }
    }
    try await group.waitForAll()
  }
}

// CASE group_unless_cancelled_plain expect=pass
func g5(_ items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      _ = group.addTaskUnlessCancelled { await work(item) }
    }
  }
}

// CASE discarding_group_priority expect=pass
func g6(_ items: [Int]) async {
  await withDiscardingTaskGroup { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask(priority: .background) { await work(item) }
    }
  }
}

// CASE group_plain_capture expect=pass
func g7(_ items: [Int], store: Store) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask { [store] in await store.save(item) }
    }
  }
}
